content.title: Ruby Rose, Australian Model, Actress
content.text: ​ Play our NEW game, Second Look, and see how sharp your eye is! Celebrity Person Ruby Rose Ruby Rose is an Australian model and actress. Before her breakthrough role as Stella Carlin on Netflix's Orange Is the New Black in 2015, Rose started her career as a model and host for MTV Australia. Rose also starred in several action movies, including Resident Evil: The Final Chapter (2016) and John Wick: Chapter 2 (2017). In 2018, she became TV's first openly gay superhero in a leading role on The CW's Batwoman.
